HatchPattern__RoughGrassland__Meta.Meta__Description: Rough grassland - unmanaged grass, tussock, field margins and uncut verges. Taller, splayed tufts with a loose leaf above them, set further apart than the Grassland tufts, in the Ordnance Survey manner. Drawn as an AREA texture.
HatchPattern__RoughGrassland__Meta.Meta__WhyTransparent: The tile paints TUFTS ONLY. The olive-grey wash beneath is the fill deck of the site plan composite, with its own colour and opacity, so it can be switched off on its own.
HatchPattern__RoughGrassland__Meta.Meta__WhyOwnInk: The tufts carry their OWN ink rather than 'inherit', for the same reason as Grassland: the Rough Grassland tag draws its edges in the OS base map grey, and an inherited ink would paint grey grass.
HatchPattern__RoughGrassland__Meta.Meta__WhyPaperUnits: Paper millimetres, like every dash pattern in the editor, so a tuft is the same size on the sheet at any drawing scale.
HatchPattern__RoughGrassland__Meta.Meta__WhyTwoTufts: Two tuft shapes, alternating, leaning opposite ways with their leaf on opposite sides. Rough grass is irregular by definition; one stamped tuft repeated would read as a planted lawn. Beside Grassland it has to read at a glance as the rougher of the two - taller blades, wider splay, a leaf, and more space between tufts.
HatchPattern__RoughGrassland__Meta.Meta__WhySparse: Nine tufts on a 32 x 30 mm tile, about one every 107 square millimetres - the reference sheet's density, and a third sparser than Grassland.
HatchPattern__RoughGrassland__Meta.Meta__WhyScatter: A blue-noise scatter, generated ONCE and written in as fixed numbers, scored on a torus against shared columns, shared rows and three tufts nearly in line - the regularities that survive a repeat. No two tufts are closer than 8.3 mm.
HatchPattern__RoughGrassland__Meta.Meta__WhyInsideTheTile: Every tuft sits wholly inside the tile, so the browser's <pattern> clip and the PDF stamper draw exactly the same marks.

HatchPattern__RoughGrassland__Identity.Identity__Description: How this pattern is named, found and grouped in the Patterns panel.
HatchPattern__RoughGrassland__Identity.Identity__Note: Referenced by 75__SitePlan__SoftLandscape__RoughGrassland in the Tags SSOT, through SitePlan__FillHatchId.

HatchPattern__RoughGrassland__Tile.Tile__Description: The repeating cell, in paper millimetres.
HatchPattern__RoughGrassland__Tile.Tile__Note: Larger than the Grassland tile, so the tufts sit further apart.

HatchPattern__RoughGrassland__Defaults.Defaults__Description: A stroke colour written as a hex is the pattern's own ink and beats the layer's line colour; 'inherit' would take the layer's.

HatchPattern__RoughGrassland__Glyphs.Glyphs__Description: Drawn about the glyph's base centre, y pointing DOWN, in tile millimetres.

RoughTuft.Glyph__Label: Rough tuft, leaf to the right
RoughTuft.Glyph__Note: A tall centre blade, a longer blade either side of it than a Grassland tuft has, an outer pair bowing away, and a loose leaf floating above the right-hand blades.

RoughTuftLeft.Glyph__Label: Rough tuft, leaf to the left
RoughTuftLeft.Glyph__Note: The same tuft turned the other way: its centre blade leans a touch left, its outer right blade bows furthest, and its leaf is on the left.

HatchPattern__RoughGrassland__Placements.Place__Note: Lower band, right - 0.2 mm clear of the right edge
Bottom band, right - its base 0.2 mm clear of the bottom edge

HatchPattern__RoughGrassland__Bounds.Bounds__Description: How far a viewport may scale and turn this pattern before it stops reading as rough grass.
